description: Small deterministic synthetic fixture for graph seed ranking, bounded traversal, and contradiction preservation. Not representative of production owner queries.

neurons.title: Principal task idempotency scope
neurons.notes: Task creation binds an idempotency key to an authenticated principal so retries cannot cross owners.

neurons.title: Principal identifier validation
neurons.notes: Host authority and session boundaries accept principal identifiers up to 256 characters.

neurons.title: Versioned idempotency digest encoding
neurons.notes: Length-prefixed tuple hashing avoids ambiguous separator and NUL byte collisions between principal IDs and idempotency keys.

neurons.title: Legacy idempotency retry compatibility
neurons.notes: Existing delimiter-hash rows remain retry compatible only when their stored owner matches the authenticated principal.

neurons.title: Authenticated host worker dispatch
neurons.notes: Host task worker passes the authenticated principal to the principal-aware handler and does not invoke the legacy handler for owned work.

neurons.title: Consent revocation invalidates export
neurons.notes: The authoritative consent registry must remain valid; revocation invalidates dependent learning exports and consumers recheck status.

neurons.title: Learning export publication recovery
neurons.notes: Pending export reconciliation verifies artifact hashes and consent dependencies before activating a publication.

neurons.title: Legacy pathless staging artifact
neurons.notes: A publishing row without a verifiable artifact path must fail closed; an unknown staging path is retained for operator inspection, not guessed deletion.

neurons.title: Atomic Notion graph snapshot limitation
neurons.notes: Neurons and Synapses data sources are fetched sequentially, so edits between reads can create a mixed-time graph snapshot.

neurons.title: Sequential graph data source reads
neurons.notes: The Notion graph provider reads the Neurons data source before the Synapses data source; the pair is not an atomic transaction.

neurons.title: Semantic embedding retrieval proposal
neurons.notes: Embeddings may improve semantic retrieval, but should be considered only after a labelled graph benchmark demonstrates a meaningful lexical retrieval gap.

neurons.title: Freshness first ranking baseline
neurons.notes: A previous retrieval baseline prioritized recency ahead of query relevance and performed poorly on the synthetic hard-negative memory fixture.

neurons.title: Export remained active after consent revocation
neurons.notes: Historical status claim superseded by authoritative consent revocation and export invalidation.

synapses.title: Task ownership depends on principal identity
synapses.rationale: Owner identity is checked consistently at task boundaries.

synapses.title: Idempotency scope uses versioned digest
synapses.rationale: The digest scopes retries to an unambiguous principal/key tuple.

synapses.title: Legacy retries preserve same-owner identity
synapses.rationale: Compatibility is constrained by the stored owner.

synapses.title: Worker dispatch depends on authenticated principal
synapses.rationale: The host-resolved principal reaches the authorized handler.

synapses.title: Export recovery depends on consent validity
synapses.rationale: An export cannot activate after a required consent is revoked.

synapses.title: Revocation contradicts historical active export claim
synapses.rationale: The historical active status is superseded by authoritative revocation.

synapses.title: Pathless staging is a recovery edge case
synapses.rationale: Publication recovery must fail closed when artifact identity is unavailable.

synapses.title: Sequential reads explain mixed-time snapshot risk
synapses.rationale: Two separate reads cannot guarantee one atomic cross-source version.

synapses.title: Embedding proposal compared with lexical baseline
synapses.rationale: Benchmark evidence should precede architecture changes.
